title: Anunnaki came to Earth to mine gold
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of Anunnaki came to Earth to mine gold, about ancient at Earth, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the story of the Anunnaki. They were coming here to mine gold and precious metals.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a man who talks about the true purpose of the Egyptian pyramids, retells on podcast host Jesse Michels's show the story of the Anunnaki, beings from ancient Middle Eastern myth. According to Drumm, they came to Earth long ago to mine gold and other precious metals. If true, humanity's distant past would have been shaped by visitors who came here for resources.
